     - Concise (current): Claude responds
       tersely, leading with results and
       skipping preamble and narration
     - Explanatory: Claude explains its
       implementation choices and codebase
       patterns
     - Learning: Claude pauses and asks you to
       write small pieces of code for
       hands-on practice

     Usage: /output-style <style>
